workflow: Run `brief` to convert the idea into a structured production brief with IP risk flags.
Run `constraints` to fix canvas, tile grid, palette budget, and file-size budgets before drawing.
Run `scope` to break the project into asset families with effort estimates.
Run `art-bible` to lock palette, outline, shading, animation, and naming rules.
Generate a starter palette (`palette-generate`) and 2-3 silhouette thumbnails (`sprite-generate`, `silhouette`).
Review the brief with stakeholders; record approvals via `license-record --status approved`.
checklist: Canvas and display scale decided before any art
pitfalls: Starting to draw before constraints are fixed
Referencing protected characters or logos instead of original designs
commands: brief out/brief.json --idea "cozy forest shrine icon set" --platform game-pc --animation idle

workflow: Block silhouettes first; check with `silhouette` at play size.
Build clusters with controlled stair-step rhythm; avoid 1-1-1 jaggies.
Add linework with `outline` (outer/inner/inline) only where it helps readability.
Use `dither` for gradients/materials; keep it deliberate, not noise.
Finish with `cleanup` to remove orphan pixels and stray alpha.
pitfalls: Anti-aliasing that blurs the pixel aesthetic
Uniform dither everywhere instead of material-driven use

workflow: Generate or extract a base palette (`palette-generate`, `palette-extract`).
Audit ramps with `palette-analyze` (duplicates, weak value steps, CVD collisions).
Apply/reduce with `palette-apply`; export indexed PNG when a transparent index is needed.
Plan recolors with `palette-swap` (index-aligned teams/costumes).
Create lighting variants with `recolor --preset night|sunset|...`.
Convert formats for editors with `palette-convert`.
checklist: Value steps readable at play size
Transparent index reserved for indexed exports

workflow: Generate base candidates with `sprite-generate --kind creature|robot|...` and a fixed seed.
Refine silhouettes manually in your editor; keep proportions animation-ready.
Build turnarounds with `transform` flips and consistent pivot via `tags --set-pivot`.
Split modular parts with `split-layers --mode component`; recombine with `composite`.
Create state/team variants with `palette-swap` and `recolor`.
Run `critique` for readability metrics before approval.
checklist: Modular layers align to a shared pivot
Facing/hit states distinguishable without color alone
pitfalls: Variants that change value structure, not just hue

workflow: Generate icon families with `icon-generate` (potion/coin/gem/sword/...).
Keep framing, light direction, and outline weight identical across the family.
Use rarity/value cues via ramps, not just hue.
Check tiny sizes with `platform-export --preset emote` and `critique`.
Batch variants with `batch` + `palette-swap` jobs.
pitfalls: 1px details that vanish at display size

workflow: Plan depth layers (sky, far, mid, near, foreground) before painting.
Generate ground/material bases with `pattern-generate` and `tileset-generate`.
Composite layers with `composite`; keep each layer editable.
Create lighting scenarios with `recolor` presets; keep the neutral master.
Add weather with `effect-generate --kind rain|snow|smoke`.
Verify panorama loops with `seam-check --preview`.
commands: composite out/scene.png sky.png mountains.png trees.png --layers-json out/layers.json

workflow: Fix tile size and projection; generate autotiles with `tileset-generate --mode 16|47`.
Preview placement with `--preview-map` (ASCII map).
Check seams with `seam-check`; fix repetition with `--variants`.
Export map data with `tilemap-export` (TMX/TSX/Tiled JSON/CSV).
Pack engine atlases with `sheet-pack --extrude 2 --padding 2`.
checklist: No visible seams in tiled preview
Collision layer aligned to art grid
pitfalls: Padding>0 tilesets fed to grid tilemap exporters (use --padding 0)
Forgetting diagonal rules in blob sets
Single-variant tiling that shows obvious repeats

workflow: Choose projection (top-down, side, front, 2:1 iso) and lock it in the art bible.
For iso/voxel work, build models with `voxel-build` and render with `voxel-render --view iso`.
Use `iso-primitive` for consistent diamond tiles/cubes.
Generate turntables with `voxel-turntable` (4 exact 90-degree views).
Audit consistency with `validate --detect-resample` and manual projection review.
pitfalls: Mixing true iso with 30-degree dimetric accidentally
Rotating pixel art at arbitrary angles

workflow: Start from a strong key pose; generate base loops with `motion-generate` (idle-bob, jump, walk-bob).
Hand-tune keys in your editor; keep feet planted on contact frames.
Set timing with `anim-encode --fps/--hold`; use `tags` for state ranges and events.
Check loop closure and duplicates with `validate` (animation checks).
Add secondary motion 1-2 frames behind the body.
checklist: No foot sliding on contact frames
pitfalls: Mirroring walk cycles without checking facing

workflow: Generate effect bases with `effect-generate` (fire, explosion, water, energy, ...).
Use `palette-cycle` for water/lava/neon signage animation from a single still.
Add impact feedback with `motion-generate --kind shake|hit-flash`.
Transitions: `motion-generate --kind dissolve`, `glitch` for signal effects.
QA with `validate` (flash risk, duplicates, loop closure).
checklist: Effect reads against both dark and light backgrounds

workflow: Extract frames with `anim-decode` (GIF/APNG/WebP) or `sheet-slice` (grid/auto).
Normalize sizes (`pad`) and trim with offset metadata (`trim --meta`).
Pack with `sheet-pack` (padding/extrusion/POT) and export metadata (`--meta-format`).
Record pivots/tags/events with `tags`; feed tags into `sheet-pack --tags-json`.
Validate the atlas with `validate sheet.json --sheet sheet.png`.
pitfalls: Trimming without recording offsets (sprites jump in engine)
Losing frame order in packed layouts
commands: sheet-pack out/frames --output out/atlas.png --layout packed --padding 2 --extrude 1 --power-of-two --meta out/atlas.json --meta-format json-hash

workflow: Work on copies; never edit the only master (overwrite guard + --force approval).
Recolor with `palette-swap`/`recolor`; replace backgrounds with `remove-bg` + `composite`.
Relight with `recolor` presets or hand-passes; keep the neutral master.
Split flattened art into layers with `split-layers` before structural edits.
Harmonize collections by applying one palette (`palette-apply`) and scale policy.
Restore damaged art with `restore` (grid detection + requantize).
pitfalls: Hue shifts that break material identity

workflow: Convert with `convert` (box downscale + palette + optional dither/cleanup/outline).
Pick native width from the target use (16/32/64/128), not from the source size.
For animation sources: `anim-decode` frames, then `convert` each with the SAME palette.
Portraits/photos: only with authorization; keep recognizable non-sensitive features.
Finish with `cleanup` and a preview at integer scale (`--preview-scale`).
checklist: No palette flicker in converted animations
pitfalls: Converting at too-high resolution (looks like a photo, not pixel art)

workflow: Build voxel models from heightmaps/boxes with `voxel-build`; edit JSON or .vox in voxel editors.
Render with `voxel-render` (iso/front/side/top); lighting is face-shaded for block clarity.
Produce 4-direction turntables with `voxel-turntable`.
Export sprite stacks with `voxel-stack` for pseudo-3D engines.
Generate normal maps for hybrid 3D with `normal-map`.
Plan shots with `storyboard-generate` (board + markdown + animatic GIF).
Assemble/preview loops with `anim-encode` (exact frame closure for ambient loops).
Add titles/lower-thirds with `text-render --effect`.
Burn captions and export SRT with `caption-render`.
Author delivery encodes with `script-author ffmpeg` (MP4/GIF/WebM pipelines).
Composite layers with `composite`; keep masters lossless.
checklist: Loop closure exact for ambient loops
pitfalls: Losing alpha in MP4 (use WebM/VP9 alpha or ProRes)
Baking captions into the only master

workflow: Define UI palette/borders with `ui-generate panel` (nine-slice margins exported).
Generate button state strips with `ui-generate button` (normal/hover/pressed/disabled/focus).
Build bars/dialogs/slots/cursors with the matching kinds.
Check contrast and CVD with `palette-analyze`; check sizes with `validate`.
Export responsive sets with `platform-export`.
checklist: Focus state visible without color alone

workflow: Render text with the built-in 5x7/3x5 bitmap fonts (`text-render`).
Export glyph atlases + mapping with `font-sheet` for engine text systems.
Animate with `--effect type|wave|bounce|flicker|rainbow`.
Check small-text contrast with `palette-analyze`; plan localization space.
Use {heart}/{star}/{coin} symbol tokens for HUD icons.
checklist: No ambiguous letterforms at target size

workflow: Generate engine files with `engine-export <target>` (godot/unity/web/phaser/pixi/...).
Follow the written setup guide for filtering (nearest), mipmaps (off), compression (none).
Use integer camera/viewport scaling; enable pixel snapping.
For retro targets, export reference palettes + constraints (`engine-export retro`).
Verify imports by reopening in the engine (manual step; see limitations).
pitfalls: Letting the engine auto-compress pixel textures
commands: engine-export godot out/godot --input out/atlas.png --atlas-json out/atlas-simple.json --name hero --fps 12

workflow: Export masters lossless (PNG/APNG); previews as GIF/WebP (`anim-encode`).
Numbered sequences for video tools: `sequence-export`.
Aseprite workflows: `aseprite-export` (sheet + JSON with tags) or `script-author aseprite-lua`.
Convert palettes for any editor with `palette-convert` (gpl/pal/act/ase/hex/json/png).
SVG pixel grids: `svg-export` (crispEdges rects).
Package masters + derivatives + checksums with `audit`.
checklist: Editor-specific project files handled in the editor (not here)

workflow: Scale only by integer factors (`scale --factor`); downscale with box when unavoidable.
Audit filtering/resample damage with `validate --detect-resample`.
Prevent atlas bleed with `sheet-pack --extrude 2 --padding 2`.
Simulate displays with `display-sim` (crt/lcd/led/gameboy/mono/1bit).
Budget file sizes with `validate --max-bytes`; optimize GIF via shared palettes.
Export thumbnails/store crops with `platform-export`.
checklist: No non-integer scaling in final delivery
Display previews are separate from masters

workflow: Define seeds + parameters; generate with `sprite-generate`/`tileset-generate`/`pattern-generate`.
Record seeds in manifests (all generators write JSON manifests).
Curate outputs with `critique` + `validate`; reject duplicates/off-palette results.
Batch controlled variants with `batch` jobs (palette-swap/recolor/scale).
Synthesize motion families with `motion-generate`/`effect-generate` at fixed seeds.
Author external scripts with `script-author` (ffmpeg/imagemagick/aseprite-lua/batch-job).
Run repeatable pipelines with `batch` (stop-on-error, structured reports).
Enforce naming with `audit --naming`; completeness with `--require`.
CI gate: `validate` + `seam-check` + `compare` + `reopen-test` with exit codes.
Diagnose failures with `reopen-test` and batch reports.
checklist: No arbitrary shell execution inside the tool

workflow: Run `validate` for dimensions/colors/alpha/grid/naming/size/animation checks.
Check tiles with `seam-check`; atlases with `validate atlas.json --sheet atlas.png`.
Regression-test against approved references with `compare --diff-image`.
Accessibility: flash-risk in `validate`, CVD in `palette-analyze`.
Completeness with `audit --require`; final artifacts with `reopen-test`.
checklist: All checks pass or are explicitly waived
pitfalls: Treating heuristic checks as artistic approval

workflow: Extract surviving frames/sprites with `anim-decode`/`sheet-slice`.
Detect native grid and restore with `restore --cleanup`.
Recover palettes with `palette-extract`; verify with `palette-analyze`.
Migrate formats with `palette-convert`/`atlas-meta`; document losses.
Archive with `audit` (checksums, provenance, licenses).
commands: audit legacy/ out/legacy-audit.json --license "used with permission" --markdown out/legacy.md

workflow: Export platform sets with `platform-export` (app-icon/emote/badge/sticker/store/social/wallpaper).
Build review/sale catalogs with `contact-sheet --labels --title`.
Add titles to key art with `text-render`; keep crops platform-safe.
Record licenses and approvals with `license-record` and `audit`.
pitfalls: One master crop stretched to every aspect

workflow: Generate lessons/guides with `guide --skill/--category` (catalog-driven).
Create practice sessions with `practice --seed`.
Critique with measurements via `critique`; score with `rubric`.
Document production rules with `art-bible`; record licenses with `license-record`.
Coordinate reviews: compare versions with `compare`, track approvals in license records.
Pick domain constraints first (accuracy, age-appropriateness, non-diagnostic symbols).
Use generators for bases: `pattern-generate`, `tileset-generate`, `icon-generate`, `ui-generate`.
Data visuals: keep values exact; encode with position/length, not just color.
Medical/safety symbols: add shape redundancy; run `palette-analyze` CVD checks.
Historical scenes: record source notes via `license-record --source`.
checklist: Domain accuracy reviewed by a human
pitfalls: Charts that distort values for style

workflow: Keep style systems as presentation layers, never baked into masters.
CRT/LCD/LED/monochrome previews: `display-sim`.
Controlled corruption: `glitch --seed --intensity`.
Emissive/neon: `effect-generate --kind energy` + `recolor --preset neon`.
Shadows: `shadow --blob`; normals: `normal-map`.
Document shader/material settings in engine guides (`engine-export`).
pitfalls: Glitch that damages file integrity (effect is pixel-level only)

workflow: Record provenance for every asset: `audit` (checksums/sources/licenses) + `license-record`.
Run IP keyword checks in `brief`; redesign flagged concepts toward originals.
Apply consent/privacy review for real-person portraits before production.
Destructive safety: outputs refuse overwrite without --force; use --dry-run first.
Verify claims with `validate`/`reopen-test` before reporting completion.
Report capabilities honestly with `capabilities` (modes + limitations).
Scan packages for secrets/unsafe paths with `audit`.
Recover from failures: batch stop-on-error + reports; fix smallest layer, rerun checks.
checklist: Completion claims backed by reopened artifacts
pitfalls: Skipping secret scans before sharing packages
